proposals.quote: be preceded by an individual notice and appropriate warning to the Subscriber in advance of any resulting service interruption or disconnection
proposals.rationale: No warning has been sent (warning_sent is false), so an immediate suspension would skip the required individual notice. The unpaid invoice is for the mobile line only, so any interruption must be confined to that service as far as technically feasible, and the home broadband should not be suspended. The warning must state the required actions, due dates and consequences. Emergency numbers must stay reachable. Term 14.2 (suspension without prior notice) does not displace these rules.

If you have already paid, reply with the payment details so we can match it to your account. Emergency numbers remain available. Your home broadband is not affected by this notice.

proposals.quote: shall specify the necessary Subscriber actions required to avoid non-payment disconnection and all due dates
proposals.rationale: The warning must tell the subscriber what to do, by when, and what follows if they do not. The subscriber's claimed payment is not yet matched to the account, so the notice invites them to send payment details.

The clauses give no minimum notice period, so the interruption date and time must be set by Sahab operations and are not invented here.
The subscriber's claimed payment of 2026-10-14 is not matched to the account. Reconcile it before any interruption proceeds.
